questions.prompt: Which sorting criteria should be supported in the TUI?
questions.description: Currently sorting only toggles between alphabetical name and modified/last_viewed_at.

options.label: Recent Activity / Last Viewed (backend last_viewed_at)
Creation Date (newest additions first)
Recent Artifact Generation (notebooks with newest audio/notes/artifacts)
Alphabetical (A-Z title)
Source Count (most sources to least)

questions.prompt: How should recent artifact generations and artifact presence be displayed?
questions.description: The goal is to make newly generated audio overviews and other artifacts immediately recognizable across hundreds of notebooks.

options.label: Compact icon badges in sidebar row (e.g. 🎙️, 📄, ⚡) + rich artifact summary & timestamps in the detail panel (Recommended)
Only glyph badges in the sidebar row to keep it minimal
Only in the right-hand Notebook Info & Details panel (keep sidebar title lines plain)

questions.prompt: How should notebooks crossing various domains or tags (e.g., `[CLAUDE]`, `[GEMINI]`, topics) be navigated?
questions.description: Titles often carry bracketed tags or domain keywords.

options.label: Render tags as distinct colored chips in sidebar + provide quick tag filter (e.g. press 't' to filter by domain tag) (Recommended)
Group notebooks into collapsible domain tree sections based on prefix tags
Keep list flat without special tag handling, rely purely on search and sorting

questions.prompt: What search and live filtering capabilities should be added?
questions.description: For navigating collections of hundreds of notebooks quickly.

options.label: Interactive title/tag search (press '/' to filter in real-time with instant keyboard navigation)
Filter by artifact presence (e.g. 'has audio overview', 'has recent artifacts')
Filter by source count (e.g. exclude empty notebooks with 0 sources)

questions.prompt: How should artifact metadata and timestamps across hundreds of notebooks be fetched without lag or API rate limits?
questions.description: Querying artifacts for hundreds of notebooks sequentially via Google API would exceed rate limits and freeze the UI.

options.label: Persist discovered artifact metadata in local cache (~/.notebooklm/tui_cache.json / SQLite) across sessions
Lazy background worker that trickles artifact metadata for visible/nearby notebooks using the token bucket
Fetch artifact details only when a notebook is focused/selected or opened

questions.prompt: How should sort modes and filters be controlled in the TUI?
questions.description: Currently 's' toggles between name and modified.

options.label: Pressing 's' opens a clean sort popup/modal menu with options [a] Name, [m] Modified, [c] Created, [g] Recent Artifacts (Recommended)
Pressing 's' cycles through sort modes sequentially, updating the sidebar header

questions.prompt: What is the scope boundary for this feature?
questions.description: Determine if changes are restricted to the TUI or should propagate to the CLI.

options.label: TUI-only: Enhance sidebar rendering, key navigation, sorting, filtering, and local artifact metadata caching (Recommended)
TUI + CLI parity: Also add `--sort` flags (created, modified, artifacts) to `notebooklm list`
